name: Koshchei
title: Soulbound Enchanter
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Already called “Deathless” for the spells that prolong his life, the sorcerer Koshchei seeks not only greater power but true immortality. He has engaged in conspiracy with Morgan Le Fay of Avalon. If successful, they would reshape the flow of aether itself to their liking—and never mind that it would cost the lives of not merely innocent mortals, but any number of gods.
archetype_description: Ignore 1% of enemy resistance for each piece of nightweave armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: At the start of this hero’s turn, reduce each enemy’s ATK and DEF by 5% (up to 4 times) which remains active whilst this hero is alive.
If the target is under RES Down or FTH Down, increase their Core ability Cooldown by 2 turns and place [Lock Ultimate] for 1 turn.
